objects.name: c_margin_markup
objects.expression: 'Margin: ' +  string((( saleprice - purprice) / if(saleprice=0, 1, saleprice)) * 100, '###,##0.00') + '%' + SPACE(1) +  ', Net Margin: ' +  string((( (saleprice - flatdisc * (1 - salediscperc * 0.01)) - purprice) / if( (saleprice - flatdisc * (1 - salediscperc * 0.01)) = 0, 1, (saleprice - flatdisc * (1 - salediscperc * 0.01)))) * 100, '###,##0.00') + '%' + SPACE(1) + ', Mark-Up: ' +  string((((saleprice - flatdisc * (1 - salediscperc * 0.01)) - purprice) / if( purprice = 0, 1, purprice)) * 100, '###,##0.00') + '%'
